scheme.name: Mukhyamantri Gyansetu Merit Scholarship Yojana
scheme.summary: The scheme aims to select 30,000 brilliant students who have completed their Class 5 education in government, aided, or RTE-approved schools and provide them with scholarships to study in selected schools from Class 6th to Class 12th.
eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
The applicant must be a student.
The applicant must have studied Classes 1st to 5th in a Government/ Government-aided/ RTE-approved self-financed primary school in Gujarat.
The applicant must have passed the Common Entrance Test (CET) conducted by the State Examination Board and be listed in the merit list.
The applicant must have taken admission in Class 6th in a Government/ Government-aided/ RTE-approved self-financed primary school in Gujarat.
scheme.benefits: Provides annual scholarships ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹25,000 based on the school type and class level.
scheme.how_to_apply: Apply online at http://gssyguj.in/ by registering with the CTS Aadhaar UDI number, filling in the details, uploading documents, and submitting the form.

summary.value: The scheme aims to select 30,000 brilliant students who have completed their Class 5 education in government, aided, or RTE-approved schools and provide them with scholarships to study in selected schools from Class 6th to Class 12th.
summary.quote: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Gyansetu Merit Scholarship Yojana" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat aims to select 30,000 brilliant students who have completed their Class 5 education consecutively in government, aided, or RTE-approved schools and provide them with scholarships to study in selected government, aided, or private schools from Class 6th to Class 12th. The selection is done through a Common Entrance Test conducted by the State Examination Board, Gandhinagar.

benefits.value: Provides annual scholarships ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹25,000 based on the school type and class level.
benefits.quote: Government Schools and Government -aided Schools (Approved by Education Department): For Class 6th to 8th: ₹5,000/- per year. For Class 9th to 10th: ₹6,000/- per year. For Class 11th to 12th: ₹7,000/- per year. Private (Selected) Schools: For Class 6th to 8th: ₹20,000/- per year. For Class 9th to 10th: ₹22,000/- per year. For Class 11th to 12th: ₹25,000/- per year.

how_to_apply.value: Apply online at http://gssyguj.in/ by registering with the CTS Aadhaar UDI number, filling in the details, uploading documents, and submitting the form.
how_to_apply.quote: Step 1:Visit the official website: http://gssyguj.in/. Step 2:Register online using the 18-digit CTS Aadhaar UDI number. Step 3:Provide mobile number, verify using OTP, and set a password to complete registration.
